notes.title: bug修复
notes.content:
修复训练营意外合成bug

Fixed a bug causing unintended synthesis in the Training Camp.

notes.title: bug修复补丁
notes.content:
修复了部分UI错误，修复了重新开始游戏后兵营刷新概率bug，修复了重新开始游戏后每日夜晚结算获得金币数量bug.

Fixed some UI issues, fixed a bug with the barracks refresh probability after restarting the game, and fixed a bug with the amount of gold obtained during daily night cycle settlements after restarting the game.
